name: Bab Al-Hara
overview: A modern classic of Arab television. A social drama set in the 1920s in Damascus- It highlights Damascene life, noble values, and ancient customs and traditions represented by the people of Harat al-Dabeh who fled to Harat al-Salihiyah after the French bombed Harat al-Dabeh. The events take place after the gold is stolen from the house of the cloth merchant Abu Ibrahim, and the guard Abu al-Samu is killed. The men of the neighborhood try to find the thief.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: The series takes place in the twenties of the last century in (Syria), in Al-Dabaa neighborhood, to begin with the theft of gold from the house of (Abu Ibrahim), a cloth merchant, and the killing of the neighborhood guard (Abu Samou), so that the men of the neighborhood gather to find the truth about the gold thief, only to discover that he (Al-Adashari), events escalate

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: Colonel Abu Shehab assumes the leadership of the neighborhood, while everyone seeks to support the revolutionary spirit, and to take revenge on the killer Setif.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: The conflict of the Syrian people continues through the neighborhood against French colonialism, which witnesses the shocking departure of Abu Issam, and the emergence of the doctor Ibn Al-Baghjati who can cure incurable diseases.

seasons.name: Season 4
seasons.overview: Events escalated when the British surrounded Haret al-Dabaa and prepared to bombard it with artillery and storm it. The French forces issue an arrest warrant for Abu Shehab, the colonel of the neighborhood, which makes him decide to flee, to move to live with the revolutionaries and participate in providing them with weapons and helping Palestine to confront the British.

seasons.name: Season 5
seasons.overview: In this part, (Abu Diab), who comes to the neighborhood and is surprised by the presence of Mamoun Bey, Faryal Khanum's husband, whom Abu Diab has known since the days of his imprisonment with Colonel Abu Shehab in Arwad prison, so he disguises himself as a fraudster scavenger.

seasons.name: Season 6
seasons.overview: In its sixth part, the series continues to convey the period of Syria's liberation from brutal French colonialism in that era of history, and this part witnesses the return of the character (Abu Essam), and witnesses the emergence of new characters, as is the custom with each new part.

seasons.name: Season 7
seasons.overview: In continuation to the events of the previous six parts, the series continues the tales of the life of (the Levant) in the thirties of the twentieth century, passing through the 1936 treaty that paved the way for the independence of (Syria), parallel to the emergence of a love story between (Moataz), the young Muslim, and the Jewish girl (Sarah), and his desire to marry her, Which ignites the fires of sedition in the neighborhood, and intersection with the events of the French occupation of the country.
